# Count successful SMTP sends at completion and keep SeaMonkey guards

The SMTP client done callback increments Glean.compose.mailsSent only after checking requestCancelled and outside MOZ_SUITE, then notifies stop. The fake SMTP unit test awaits actual send completion and checks multiple mails. Do not move this count to compose creation, FileLink decision or SendLater queueing, and do not claim this SMTP implementation proves all other transports count identically.

Scope: smtp-telemetry.
